The design goals in Table 2-8-G should be applied at 50 ft (15 m) from the shaft outlet or other ancillary facility or should be applied at the setback line of the nearest buildings or occupied area, whichever is the shorter distance. Transient noise design goals apply to short time duration events such as train passby noise transmitted from vent shaft openings.
